name: Databricks Unity Catalog
summary: Register Parquet that Ogun published to object storage as external tables in Databricks Unity Catalog, using a personal access token or OAuth.

fields.name: access_token
fields.label: Personal access token
fields.help: Created in the Databricks workspace. Store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: workspace_host
settings.label: Workspace host
settings.help: Host name of the workspace, without https://.

operators.summary: Register a published Parquet prefix as an external table in a Unity Catalog schema.

notes: The storage path must already be covered by an external location in Unity Catalog; Ogun does not create locations or storage credentials. Loading data with COPY INTO is a warehouse load (ADR 0012), not this connector. Check the Databricks documentation for the table API of your edition.
